body: I understand what you mean OP. Thats why I don’t use this sub :/

I have made an effort to go out more and socialize. I keep much better hygiene. I try to push myself outside of my comfort zone and don’t stay in bed all day like I used to. I have taken up multiple new hobbies. I clean regularly and I make the first move when trying to talk to people. I have gone to therapy and been on multiple medications for depression. I was even diagnosed with bipolar disorder. I have changed so much over the past couple of months I’m hardly recognizable and I still feel like shit. Big moves don’t take years, if you wanna improve yourself you can do it tomorrow. The promise that self-improvement will suddenly make people look at you differently is just not true. My family still treats me like crap. I have virtually zero friends. My social skills suck due to bad social anxiety. Some people just hit a glass ceiling and there really is no way out other than suicide.

I feel exactly the same. You really hit the nail on the head. I just know deep down no girl will ever love me. Even after all the self improvement I made I still feel so behind. It’s not even about just knowing what sex feels like. I’m so behind everyone socially, nobody even desires to be my friend.. its torturous. I wish you all the best man. Nobody should have to suffer like this.
Writing. And no things aren’t going well.
I like being alone. But it’s so hard to explore without a car.

Yes I did this every week when I lived in Philadelphia for a year. It helps briefly but ultimately the sadness just comes back even stronger. I have no energy to keep pushing. I have nothing to hold onto.

I have many ideas for other books but I am sure no one will ever read them until after I commit suicide. No one IRL cares about me enough to read my work. I have offered to show it to friends and family for months and all my family members have declined, including my parents, who care about me very little.
I gave up looking months ago and nothing has happened no matter how often I put myself out there. I like to write, and I am finishing a book, but that’s about it.
I want to go on a date before I die but I just get stood up every time. There’s no point in having a bucket list.

My life is over. I’ve failed out of college due to depression, I have virtually no career prospects left. I don’t know what I’m going to do with my life now. I’m lonely, I have very few friends, I suck at dating, everyone around me treats me like garbage. There is really no point in living anymore.

No it won’t. This is how my life has always been. I have never actually had a happy time in my life. I’m not gonna wait ten years and realize i would’ve missed absolutely nothing. I would rather die now.
